body:
This method should not execute the method `delete` from referenced class in `hasmany`?

I say this, because if the methods `afterDelete` or `beforeDelete` are implemented in referenced class, they will not run

`unlink()` does the same and executes the delete on the database directly not using the AR interface.
how should unlink() behave if delete returns false?

Good question!

if is transactional all should be reverted

Otherwise, I have no answer :(
this is quite a serious issue that removes more data than expected. Imo we should either fix it in RC or remove the function and add it back after final release.
@cebe Does `unlink()` have the same issue? How should we solve it?

Yes, unlink has the same issue but it is not as critical as with unlinkAll() as you explicitly pass the record to unlink to `unlink()` while unlinkAll() removed all records directly.
I have created failing unit tests for this issue: 9ee7632 on branch [unlink-tests](https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/compare/unlink-tests).

The fix would be to consider the where condition of the relation when creating the update/delete commands.
I removed the two test cases about `unlink()`. I don't think we can do anything about it but to require users to only unlink models that are truly related (should be usual).

issue.body:
The fix for #3725 doesn't work for elasticsearch as the relation query may use `filter` and `query` to specify additional query conditions. 

The corresponding unit tests are marked as skipped currently for elasticsearch: `ActiveRecordTest::testUnlinkAllAndConditionSetNull()` and `testUnlinkAllAndConditionDelete()`.
